__provenance__.statement: THIS FILE IS SYNTHESISED FROM A DOCUMENT AND IS NOT A CAPTURE. It was written by reading docs/opnsense-api-survey.md, section Push sources (which cites opnsense/core 26.7.3, syslog-ng's documentation and Unbound 1.26.1), never by recording what a firewall sent. If the survey is wrong about a header, a framing or a message, the tests that read this file pass and the reception is still wrong. Do not treat this file as evidence; replace it with recorded lines rewritten under X1 once LV-SY has run.
__provenance__.survey_section: Push sources: remote syslog and NetFlow export, read from source for push sources
__provenance__.field_list_from: S8: [pid:thread] info: client name type class, then for a reply rcode seconds.microseconds cached size, optionally on transport address port
__provenance__.why_these_values: Unbound's lines as a target with no program filter sends them: a reply with the RFC 5424 option on, a query line, a reply without the option (RFC 3164, year-less), a reply naming the address it answered on, and an informational line that is not a query.
__provenance__.example_values_are_not_a_network: Every address is a synthesised documentation address (RFC 5737, RFC 3849) and every device, host and domain name a synthesised example name.
